answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and confined to the primary region, which matches the archived regional-degradation pattern where failover restored latency and recovered errors without dropping traffic. Rollback is ruled out by the non-revertible security patch (despite memory_b1). Circuit breaking would fail-fast customer writes, violating the no-lost-writes objective. Read-replica routing historically offloaded report/dashboard reads, not the write path. Pre-peak headroom helped a surge once, but this is an in-region write-path failure at settlement peak, so capacity is a weaker match. Verifying memory_b2 before commit; peak settlement writes are a downstream-value risk, and the archive may not fully apply.
